behavior: The owner proposes and withdraws scope changes on the job page, and the client accepts each on the quote page; the record lists them
acceptance: On an accepted job with fewer than 10 payments and no change waiting, Propose a change opens a dialog (title, Amount in USD, days to pay) that adds the change with an Idempotency-Key per filled-in form; an empty or wrong field is named before anything is sent.
A waiting change shows 'Waiting for the client', stays out of the total, and has Withdraw (DELETE, with a toast); Mark done skips it.
On the quote page the waiting change has an Accept change form (name, email) that posts proposedAt exactly as the read gave it; then the change shows as accepted and focus moves there.

The record adds 'Change proposed' and 'Change accepted by' events in order; tests: web unit tests for the bodies (proposedAt sent exactly) and the record order; the public e2e accepts a change on fixed answers; the live e2e opens the dialog on a job read as accepted; axe clean, 390 px fit.
DESIGN.md describes the change UI on both pages.
